notes: The text's CalGETC section ('CalGETC Area Overview') lists only the areas (1A-1C, 2, 3A-3B, 4, 5A-5C, 6) and points to an external CalGETC requirements page via a placeholder '(link the CalGETC requirements page)'; it prints no courses, no unit requirements and no total, so no blocks were recorded.

The course lists on these pages belong to 'Hartnell College Local General Education' (HCGE), a different GE pattern with an Area 7 (Lifelong Learning & Self-Development) that CalGETC does not have. Those lists were not recorded as the CalGETC certificate's requirements. A reviewer should check whether the actual CalGETC course list (on the linked page or elsewhere in the catalog) should be used instead.
Every closed-list course appears in the HCGE lists, which suggests the closed list may have been built from approved GE courses; a reviewer should confirm the intended source.
No total units, program learning outcomes or careers are printed for the CalGETC certificate in this text.
